title: HCP — Export — payload
description: The request payload of the HCP 2.0-draft-3 Export operation (HCP 5.4.1, 5.4; `GET /v2/export` in HCP 9.4.8): a Management Client, acting for the Context Subject, asks the provider for the Context Subject's own export. HCP defines no request schema for this operation; the members are HCP 5.4.1's export options, which HCP 9.4.8 carries as query parameters. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3. Every maxLength, maxItems and maxProperties in this schema is a Trust Tasks framework bound (SPEC §7.3 item 19), not an HCP requirement; so is every minLength or minItems of 1 on a member HCP's own schema allows to be empty.

excludeDeleted.description: HCP's "excluding deleted entries" export option (HCP 5.4.1), `exclude=deleted` in HCP 9.4.8: omit entries whose `record.status` is `deleted`. Absent or false means deleted entries are exported, as HCP's default requires.

includeVersions.description: HCP's "including versions" export option (HCP 5.4.1), `include=versions` in HCP 9.4.8: also return the superseded versions of each entry returned. Absent or false means the current version only.

includeAudit.description: HCP's "including the audit log" export option (HCP 5.4.1, 8.3), `include=audit` in HCP 9.4.8: also return the Context Subject's audit log in the structure of HCP 8.2. Absent or false means no audit log.

accessToken.description: The Management Client's HCP access token (HCP 9.3), carried unchanged. HCP's HTTP binding sends it as a Bearer token; this member carries it in the document. The provider validates it exactly as over HTTP and treats it as opaque. The maxLength is a framework bound, not an HCP requirement. OPTIONAL: where it is absent, the provider authenticates the request's `issuer` VID, by the REQUIRED request proof, as a Management Client the Authorizing Principal enrolled (HCP 3.2.3), and refuses any other issuer with permissionDenied; where it is present, the token rules apply unchanged. Pending HCP confirmation (question 56).

Response.title: HCP — Export — response payload
Response.description: The Context Subject's export (HCP 5.4.1). HCP's HTTP binding answers with the export document itself as the body (HCP 9.4.8); this payload wraps it, unchanged, in the one member `export`, so that the payload stays closed while the export, like HCP's own shape, stays open. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

export.description: The HCP export document (HCP 5.4.1), unchanged: the current version of every entry not hard-deleted, whatever its status, unless `excludeDeleted` was asked; the standing rules, directives and delegations; and superseded versions and the audit log where asked. Its `options` records the options used.
